Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets. On November 1, 2026, Tripadvisor, Inc., a Nevada corporation (the “ Company ”), consummated the sale of the legal entities comprising the Company’s online restaurant reservation and management platform in Europe known as “TheFork” (the “ Business ”) to American Express Travel Related Services Company, Inc., a New York corporation (“ Buyer ”), pursuant to the Equity Purchase Agreement entered into on August 2, 2026 (the “ Equity Purchase Agreement ”). Under the terms of the Equity Purchase Agreement, Buyer acquired the Business for $700 million, subject to certain adjustments, in an all-cash transaction (the “ Transaction ”). Concurrently with the consummation of the Transaction, the Company and Buyer entered into a Transition Services Agreement dated as of November 1, 2026, pursuant to which the Company agreed to provide certain services to the Buyer for a period of 12 months unless otherwise specified therein, in order to facilitate a smooth transition of the Business. The foregoing description of the Equity Purchase Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Equity Purchase Agreement, a copy of which was filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the Company’s Current Report on Form 8-K filed on August 3, 2026 and is incorporated herein by reference. The Transaction constituted a significant disposition for purposes of Item 2.01 of Form 8-K. The Company expects to discuss the Transaction in its third quarter 2026 earnings call scheduled for November 5, 2026.
